name: LOOKUP JOIN is a left join that emits one row per match
semantics: languages_lookup must be an index.mode: lookup index. Language 2 has two lookup rows, so Jana and Lucie appear twice; Tomas (NULL key) keeps one row with NULL lookup columns.
query: FROM employees | KEEP emp_no, languages | LOOKUP JOIN languages_lookup ON languages | SORT emp_no, language_name
